conclusion: 今日主线是: agent 工作台正在从“能接更多入口”进入“谁能批准、谁能保留数据、谁能花预算”的治理阶段。OpenAI Codex 0.152.0/0.152.1 把长任务超时、MCP 工具输出上限、凭证刷新、审批恢复和不可信后端 URL 拦截推到前台；ChatGPT iOS/Remote 的队列同步、后台发送和任务优先级让手机更像控制面，但最终证据仍要回到 Mac/Codex。GitHub 侧同日出现 Copilot PR approve、个人预算到期日、Claude Fable 5.1 数据保留政策、Copilot CLI 插件面板和组织登录钉扎，说明高能力 agent 不再只是模型选择，而是审批权、路径白名单、数据保留、预算有效期和跨设备收口的系统设计。
excerpt: 2026-09-02 的重点是 Codex 0.152.x 稳定基线、iOS Remote 队列同步、Copilot 审批权和预算到期治理。
今天的判断很明确: 手机可以派工和补充指令，但审批、预算、数据保留和最终发布证据要分层记录。

signals.title: ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.237 syncs queued prompts with connected hosts
signals.author: OpenAI / ChatGPT & Codex changelog
signals.summary: iOS queued prompts can remain editable, sync with connected hosts, send in the background, and surface running tasks, unread updates, and response-needed tasks in a Priority view.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Treat iPhone/Remote as a control plane: dispatch, edit queues, copy thread IDs, and approve low-risk prompts, while Mac/Codex keeps final evidence.

signals.title: Codex CLI 0.152.1 fixes Guardian approval review for Node REPL policies
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: The fix means automatic approval review must honor model-metadata policy for Node REPL use, tightening the boundary between assistant reasoning and executable JavaScript.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Add Node REPL policy readback to any auto-approval checklist before enabling broader agent execution.

signals.title: Codex CLI 0.152.0 adds longer shell command timeouts and MCP output limits
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: The release adds app-server shell command deadlines over one hour, package-style MCP names, per-tool output_token_limit, credential-refresh progress, and usage-plan actions in rate-limit banners.
signals.takeaway: 动作: For long Codex work, record timeout owner, MCP name, output ceiling, credential refresh state, and usage action separately.

signals.title: Codex 0.153 alpha builds continue immediately after 0.152 stable
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: Multiple 0.153 alpha releases appeared around the same day, so the stable baseline and prerelease observation lane are already diverging.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Keep 0.152.x as the stable validation baseline and put 0.153 alpha in a separate no-auto-promote lane.

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.83-1 moves MCP config into the plugins dashboard
signals.author: GitHub / GitHub releases
signals.summary: The CLI now opens MCP config and MCP add/edit/authenticate forms in the plugins dashboard, shows bundled built-in plugins, and lets admins pin sign-in to approved GitHub organizations.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Unify plugin and MCP inventory review, and add an organization sign-in pin check before enterprise CLI rollout.

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.83-0 adds HTTPS proxy mTLS and sandbox policy visibility
signals.author: GitHub / GitHub releases
signals.summary: Model and web requests can use automatic HTTPS proxy mTLS client certificates, while /sandbox policy groups path grants by source and shows detected developer tools.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Maintain a proxy credential boundary and a sandbox grant receipt for every agent CLI environment.

signals.title: Copilot code review can now approve pull requests in public preview
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Admins can authorize Copilot to sign off on approvals; the ability is off by default and configurable at enterprise, organization, and repository levels, including file-path limits.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Split assessment from approval: keep AI review comments always visible, but require explicit policy before AI approval counts toward merge rules.

signals.title: GitHub adds expiration dates for individual user budgets
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Business and Enterprise admins can set budget expiration at the next billing cycle or a specific date, including through the Budgets REST API expires_at field.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Give temporary agent trials expiring budgets instead of permanent allowances; report expires_at with every high-cost lane.

signals.title: Claude Fable 5.1 becomes available in GitHub Copilot with data-retention requirements
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: The model is aimed at long-horizon autonomous coding, but requires data retention by default unless eligible enterprise zero-retention access is approved and enabled.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Before selecting a long-horizon model, record data-retention mode, admin policy, billing mode, rollout status, and eligible surfaces.

signals.title: Copilot cloud agent, github.com Chat, and GitHub Mobile are converging to one policy
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: GitHub says these surfaces will relaunch under a unified policy no earlier than September 28, 2026, with cloud agent leveraging Sandbox and github.com Chat moving to agent sessions.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Audit mobile, browser, and cloud-agent defaults before policy convergence, especially retention and review-effort defaults.

signals.title: GitHub Copilot in VS Code August releases emphasize Agent Host sessions
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Agent sessions can be arranged side by side, continued across applications, connected from multiple VS Code windows, and paired with integrated browser annotations and token usage visibility.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Create a session mobility checklist: origin app, active host, side chat, prompt timeline, diff context, browser feedback, and per-model usage.

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK Python 0.22.0 hardens replay and usage accounting
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: The release redacts blocked terminal tool output from replayable state, rejects terminal failed/incomplete Responses, rejects ignored explicit-client options, and isolates usage between independent RunState checkpoints.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Add blocked-output replay, terminal failure, explicit-client, and checkpoint usage tests before SDK upgrades.

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK JS 0.17.0 fails closed on ambiguous approval checkpoint replay
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: The JS SDK blocks ambiguous serialized approval replays, withholds rejected final tool output in SDK-owned replay surfaces, and clarifies that external side effects are not undone automatically.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Use a replay-safe guardrail contract for live RunState, serialized checkpoints, new runs, and application-owned logs.

signals.title: Claude Code hooks define lifecycle checkpoints for agent workflows
signals.author: Anthropic Docs
signals.summary: Claude Code hooks document lifecycle events around tool use, notifications, stop/subagent stop, pre-compaction, and session end, which are useful as a vocabulary for agent evidence gates.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Map agent workflows into lifecycle hooks: pre-tool, post-tool, notification, stop, pre-compact, and session-end evidence.

knowledge.title: Connected-Host Queue Receipt
knowledge.summary: 把手机、Remote、桌面和云端之间的排队提示当作可审计任务信封。
playbook: 记录 origin device、connected host、queued prompt、editable window、background-send status 和 thread ID。
手机只能派工、补充和低风险审批；最终文件、测试、commit、push、deploy 仍由 Mac/Codex 收口。
队列发送后必须回读任务状态，不能把“已发送”当作“已完成”。
knowledge.risk: 队列同步越顺手，越容易把控制面误当执行面。

knowledge.title: Approval Authority Split
knowledge.summary: 把“AI 认为可以通过”和“AI 的批准计入合并规则”拆成两层。
playbook: 默认只允许 AI 给 assessment 和 comments。
只有 enterprise/org/repo policy 明确开启且路径白名单命中时，approval 才能计入 required approvals。
新 commit 推送后重新请求审查，旧批准自动失效。
knowledge.risk: 没有拆层时，团队会误把建议性结论当成正式审批。

knowledge.title: Expiring Budget Lane
knowledge.summary: 给临时 agent 试验设置会自动到期的预算，而不是永久额度。
playbook: 为每个试验记录 owner、plan、budget、expires_at、允许模型和允许工具。
预算到期前复核是否保留、扩容或关闭。
高成本模型和长任务必须和到期预算绑定。
knowledge.risk: 无到期预算会让一次试验变成长期开销。

knowledge.title: Model Retention Policy Gate
knowledge.summary: 选长任务模型前先确认数据保留、零保留资格和管理员策略。
playbook: 记录模型、供应商、适用入口、是否默认保留数据、ZDR/例外资格和计费模式。
需要保留数据的模型默认不上私有代码和敏感知识库。
管理员启用策略本身也要作为显式确认记录。
knowledge.risk: 高能力模型不等于同一隐私边界。

knowledge.title: MCP Output Ceiling Contract
knowledge.summary: 给每个 MCP 工具配置输出上限和恢复后一致截断规则。
playbook: 记录 server name、tool name、output_token_limit、截断提示和恢复后行为。
长输出工具先做摘要或分页，再进入模型上下文。
公开输出前扫描凭证、本地路径和非公开状态。
knowledge.risk: 工具输出过大时，截断不一致会破坏恢复、审批和复盘。
